split: 215 programmes 1/2/4 for training, including README-exposed R50 sample. Single held programme 3, 50 runs in 10 condition cells. The published headline, Table 1 aggregate and figure descriptions are prior. No numerical programme3 CSV outcome trajectory opened. Shared rig, no independent-apparatus or raw online claim.
observation: 30Hz coindexed 24mm-bore Q and optical readings, unknown hardware response and radial sampling. Whole archived processed records only: first30s background and station-specific outcome-derived 1%-peak clipping done by publisher. Both donors 2.68/4.89m plus entire measured flow allowed, three target gauges 7.08/8.92/13.06m; 0.5 saturated and 10.98 noisy unused. No held peak/duration/warp/centroid used by predictors. Full V/A native coordinate with trapezoid quadrature. Grid centered on 2.68m input centroid [-32,96)m ds=1/16m; forecasts outside grid zero, all target tails mandatory.
methods: Cumulative-volume Gaussian routing Eq4/6/7 from each donor with reach Reynolds over input-predicted transit; train-fitted blend of donor routes and train-fitted Gaussian delay/width; two-input complex ridge with Re/ramp features and leave-one-training-program-out ridge choice. Two effective slownesses with Fourier phase differences and ridge when two projected modes are indistinguishable. Physical coefficients trained only on 215 records. All arms share the available inputs. No use of author target-fit transit/D. Same positivity projection for all arms. Single-speed ablation. Exact solver grids, regularization and weights fixed in frozen Python source.
metrics: Registered loss full native ∫|pred−measured|ds / ∫|measured|ds. All held 50×3 scored, no fit to held. 5 repeats per declared condition, three stations and ten cells equally weighted. Four joint gates strict against every required comparator on mean, worst condition, during-ramp mean, and farthest station. Full worst raw trace and outside-grid quantities. Unusable required input or empty physical target refuses full roster, no dropping. Differences are conditional on archive sampling, processing and single held programme.
expected_contents: Seven arms including one ablation. The predeclared publication-family Eq6 is a numerical reconstruction; archive includes CSV, workbook and README but no author executable. It scores against the known curve after predicting the mean transit from upstream/day information. Empirical ridge uses both complex donor coefficients × three deterministic flow features on every bin. Conditional two-speed solver penalizes near-singular modal differences. Four transfer gates and all raw worst cases are compulsory. The archive-wide all-five-repeat, ten-cell grouping comes from the corrected raw Excel metadata job. Full-profile predictions are in ppb. Upstream normalization and target-dependent error denominators are kept separate.
